gaps.sentence: Police are looking ___ the cause of the crash.
Don't ___ up all the milk — we need some for breakfast.
gaps.explanation: use up = finish the whole supply of something.

gaps.sentence: The factory laid ___ two hundred workers.
gaps.explanation: lay off = dismiss workers because there is not enough work.

gaps.sentence: We found ___ that the flight had been cancelled.
Wake ___ — you'll be late for school!
The strike brought ___ major changes in the law.
Do come round ___ dinner next week.
gaps.explanation: come round = visit; come round FOR dinner/TO our place.

gaps.sentence: They want to try ___ the new software before buying.
gaps.explanation: try out = test something to see if it works.
